about: Run list for the Coherence Wall page (analysis/make_mono_page.py). fs / src = the run's focal spread (A rms) and source FWHM (A); group = the page section; control = the fixed-probe run a mode leg is compared with; modes = its probe modes. A run with several tags takes the first that has landed, in order: own kernels (final), then a tag with '_kern-' (atoms read with the fixed-probe control's kernels: shown as provisional), then the plain run (volume only); 'legs' gives each tag's recon leg. 'pending' is shown until something has landed.

real_source_note: effective source size at the specimen, 24-60 pm (Müller et al. 2006), measured with 25-40 mrad apertures and including instabilities
phase2: Phase 2 (B): phonons at 100 K (liquid-nitrogen holders) and 20 K (liquid helium; the Debye model's zero-point floor) at 2.5 A + 0.1 A. Room temperature is out. Next: D, the dose series 1e5-1e8 with the searched start.

cam.cite: Wolfson Electron Microscopy Suite, University of Cambridge: Thermo Fisher Spectra 300
cam.supports: X-FEG/Mono tuned to an energy resolution of 90 meV at 300 kV, with ~50 pm STEM resolution

installs_note: Sites with a public facility page found on 2026-10-21, sorted by the gun each page names. Every count is a lower bound: Thermo Fisher and JEOL publish no installed-base figures, and many instruments (industry, much of Asia) have no public English page. "Inferred": the page gives an energy resolution only the UltiMono reaches.
